correctness.rationale: The Hadamard incidence construction and distance-regular intersection numbers yield four explicit eigenvalues of d^p on the centered subspace with verified multiplicities. A nonstandard strict-concavity bound proves uniqueness of the F_k interior root; the other root is strictly monotone. The exact threshold follows from their signs, with the k=4 cube boundary, endpoint ranks, and inverse-order asymptotics checked analytically. Independently constructed Paley and Sylvester graphs confirm the distance-power spectra for selected orders; finite checks are not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: Exact natural metric/functional-analytic threshold for every graph of an existing Hadamard order, showing a genuine change of extremizing eigenspace from order 8 to 12, determining sharp Hilbert snowflake dimensions, and revealing asymptotic collapse as 1/(k log(4/3)). Beyond a table recomputation, it supplies new root analysis and a quantified sharp infinite-family law.
